name: goldprop-vo-1
text:
My uncle says property never falls. My aunt says... just buy gold. [short pause] Who's right? Let's check the numbers.
Gold first. In 2010, ten grams cost about eighteen and a half thousand rupees. This month? About one lakh thirty-seven thousand. Roughly seven times.
But this month, gold also fell sixteen hundred rupees... in a single weekend.
Now property. The RBI tracks home prices in eighteen cities. In one quarter last year, that index actually fell. [short pause] So yes, property falls too. Quietly.
Lately, it is up about three and a half percent a year.
Here's what the gold chart misses: a flat can pay you rent, or save yours. Gold just sits in the locker.
And gold sells in minutes. A flat takes months, and stamp duty in Delhi starts at six percent.
Send this to the uncle who says property never falls.
